entries.title: Psalms 85:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm for the sons of Korah. O LORD, You have been gracious to Your land; You have brought back the captivity of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 85:2
segments: You have forgiven the iniquity of Your people; You have covered all their sins. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 85:3
segments: You have taken away all Your wrath; You have turned from the heat of Your anger.

entries.title: Psalms 85:4
segments: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause Your anger toward us to cease.

entries.title: Psalms 85:5
segments: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to all generations?

entries.title: Psalms 85:6
segments: Will You not give us life again, so that Your people may rejoice in You?

entries.title: Psalms 85:7
segments: Show us Your mercy, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 85:8
segments: I will hear what God the LORD will speak; for He will speak peace to His people, and to His saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

entries.title: Psalms 85:9
segments: Surely His salvation [is] near those that fear Him, so that glory may dwell in our land.

entries.title: Psalms 85:10
segments: Mercy and truth have met together; righteousness and peace have kissed [each other].

entries.title: Psalms 85:11
segments: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from Heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 85:12
segments: Yea, the LORD shall give good; and our land shall yield its increase.

entries.title: Psalms 85:13
segments: Righteousness shall go before Him and shall set [us] in the way of His steps.
